long.title: How Wolves Became Dogs (The Funny History of Man's Best Friend)
long.comment:
🐺➡️🐶 SCORE CHECK: how many did you get out of 4?

Answers: 1 FALSE (cousins, not grandkids) · 2 TRUE · 3 FALSE · 4 TRUE

Drop your score AND your dog's name 👇
long.description:
How did a wild wolf turn into the dog on your couch? Campfire scraps, a 14,000-year-old good boy, a Soviet fox experiment, the muscle behind puppy dog eyes, ancient Egyptian dog art and the Victorian breed boom. Four TRUE or FALSE checkpoints along the way, so keep score 👇

0:00 Cold open
0:21 Where dogs came from
1:22 The campfire deal
2:03 The 14,000 year old good boy
2:51 The fox experiment
3:35 Puppy dog eyes
4:25 Dogs meet farming
4:46 Ancient Egypt and Rome
5:45 Pampered pups
6:01 The breed explosion
7:12 The dog that went wild
7:33 Dogs today
8:05 Scores

Subscribe: next time, how cats took over the world.
